what: a hole of diameter 10 drilled into the top of a truncated cone whose top is also diameter 10 (the hole wall meets the cone at the top rim)
method: truncated cone r=15 at the base, r=5 at z=20: V = pi*20/3*(15^2+15*5+5^2) = 6806.78; the flat-bottomed hole r=5, 10 deep from the top lies inside the cone (the cone is wider below z=20): minus pi*25*10 = 785.40. V = 6021.38. Faces: base, cone, hole wall, hole floor = 4
